name: Second Wind
description: On your turn, use a bonus action to heal 1d10 + your fighter level hit points.
Once used, you need a short or long rest before using it again.

name: Action Surge
uses: Per short or long rest, see Uses
description: On your turn, take one extra action in addition to your normal action and any bonus action.
Needs a short or long rest to use again. From level 17 you get two uses between rests, but only one per turn.

name: Indomitable
trigger: You fail a saving throw
description: When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it. You must keep the new roll.
Each use needs a long rest to recover. See Uses for how many uses you have.

name: Protection
trigger: An enemy you can see attacks someone else within 5 ft
description: Shield in hand, you can throw off attacks on allies beside you. If a creature you can see attacks another target within 5 ft of you, spend your reaction: that attack roll has disadvantage.

name: Defense
description: You get +1 AC for as long as you are wearing armor. Always on; it stops working when you take the armor off.

name: Weapon Bond
description: A 1-hour ritual (a short rest works) ties you to one weapon. Keep it within reach throughout, and touch it at the end to seal the bond.
A bonded weapon cannot be disarmed from you unless you are incapacitated. While it is on your plane, you can call it to your hand as a bonus action on your turn; it teleports there instantly.
At most 2 weapons can be bonded to you at once, and each bonus action summons only one of them. Bonding a third needs you to break one existing bond first.

name: Superiority Dice
uses: Refill on short or long rest
description: Your pool of special dice that pay for maneuvers. Spend 1 die per maneuver, and use only one maneuver on each attack. Every spent die comes back after a short or long rest.
Maneuver save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).
You know 3 maneuvers at level 3, and learn 2 more at levels 7, 10 and 15. You may swap one maneuver whenever you learn new ones.

name: Know Your Enemy
description: Study or chat with a creature for 1 minute or more, away from combat. The DM tells you whether it ranks above, below or level with you in 2 traits you pick. Options: any of the 3 physical scores, AC, current HP, overall class levels, or fighter levels.

name: Relentless
trigger: You roll initiative with 0 superiority dice
description: Roll initiative with every superiority die spent, and you get 1 die back.

name: War Magic
trigger: You cast a cantrip with your action
description: Cast a cantrip as your action, and you may follow it with 1 weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Eldritch Strike
trigger: You hit with a weapon attack
description: A creature you hit with a weapon attack suffers disadvantage on its next save against one of your spells. The spell must land before your next turn ends.

name: Arcane Charge
trigger: You use Action Surge
description: Action Surge now comes with a blink: teleport up to 30 ft into an unoccupied space you can see, either before or after the extra action.

name: Improved War Magic
trigger: You cast a spell with your action
description: After you use your action to cast any spell, make 1 weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Archery
description: You get +2 to attack rolls made with ranged weapons. It is always on, so there is nothing to activate.

name: Dueling
description: Holding a melee weapon in one hand with no other weapon in your other hand gives you +2 to damage rolls with it.

name: Great Weapon Fighting
description: Wielding a melee weapon with two hands, if a damage die shows 1 or 2 you may roll it again, and the second result stands even if it is low too. Only weapons that are two-handed or versatile qualify.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: When fighting with two weapons, your second attack also adds your ability modifier to its damage.

name: Commander's Strike
trigger: You take the Attack action
description: When you take the Attack action, trade one of your swings for a bonus action that sends a friendly creature who sees or hears you into battle. Spend the die: that creature uses its reaction for one weapon attack, with the die added to the damage.

name: Disarming Attack
trigger: Your weapon attack hits
description: The die joins the damage roll. Name an item the target holds; it must pass a Strength save or let go, and the item falls at its feet.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.

name: Distracting Strike
trigger: Your weapon attack hits
description: The die joins the damage roll, and you open the target up for your friends: until your next turn starts, the first attack roll someone else makes against it has advantage.

name: Evasive Footwork
trigger: You move
description: When you move, roll the die and add the result to your AC. The bonus lasts until you stop moving.

name: Feinting Attack
description: Use a bonus action to feint at a creature within 5 feet. Your next attack roll against it has advantage, and if that attack hits you add the die to the damage.

name: Goading Attack
trigger: Your weapon attack hits
description: The die joins the damage roll, and the target must pass a Wisdom save or fixate on you. Until your next turn ends, it rolls with disadvantage when it attacks anyone but you.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.

name: Lunging Attack
trigger: You make a melee attack on your turn
description: Your reach for that one attack grows by 5 feet. If it hits, add the die to the damage.

name: Maneuvering Attack
trigger: Your weapon attack hits
description: The die joins the damage roll. An ally who can see or hear you may then use its reaction for a move of up to half its speed, and your target can't make opportunity attacks against it for that move.

name: Menacing Attack
trigger: Your weapon attack hits
description: The die joins the damage roll, and the target must pass a Wisdom save or be frightened of you. The fear lasts until your next turn ends.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.

name: Parry
trigger: Another creature damages you with a melee attack
description: When another creature hits you with a melee attack, spend a reaction and the die to cut the damage by the die roll plus your Dexterity modifier.

name: Precision Attack
trigger: You make a weapon attack roll
description: Add the die to the attack roll. You can do this before or after rolling, but before the attack's effects are applied.

name: Pushing Attack
trigger: Your weapon attack hits
description: The die joins the damage roll. A Large or smaller target must pass a Strength save or you shove it up to 15 ft straight away from you.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.

name: Rally
description: On your turn, spend a bonus action to steady an ally who can see or hear you. Roll the die; the ally gets that many temporary hit points plus your Charisma modifier.

name: Riposte
trigger: A melee attack misses you
description: Strike back at the creature that missed: one melee weapon attack against it. On a hit, the die joins the damage roll.

name: Sweeping Attack
trigger: Your melee weapon attack hits
description: Carry the swing into a second creature that is within 5 ft of the first target and within your reach. Compare your original attack roll to its AC; if that roll would hit it, it takes damage equal to the die, of the original attack's damage type.

name: Trip Attack
trigger: Your weapon attack hits
description: The die joins the damage roll. A Large or smaller target must pass a Strength save or fall prone.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.

name: Arcane Shot
trigger: Your magic arrow hits (or you fire it, for an option with no attack roll)
description: Once per turn, during the Attack action, you may load one of your Arcane Shot options into a magic arrow shot from a longbow or shortbow. You choose after the arrow hits, unless the option makes no attack roll.
You have 2 uses and regain all of them on a short or long rest. From level 15 (Ever-Ready Shot), if you roll initiative with no uses left, you regain 1.
You know 2 options at level 3 and learn 1 more at levels 7, 10, 15 and 18; at 18 every option improves. Save DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier.

name: Curving Shot
trigger: Your attack with a magic arrow misses
description: Bonus action: reroll the missed attack at another target no more than 60 ft from the first.

name: Prestidigitation
description: Take prestidigitation as your Arcane Archer Lore cantrip. The same feature also makes you proficient in your pick of Arcana or Nature.

name: Druidcraft
description: Take druidcraft as your Arcane Archer Lore cantrip. The same feature also makes you proficient in your pick of Arcana or Nature.

name: Banishing Arrow
trigger: Your magic arrow hits
description: Abjuration. The creature hit makes a Charisma save. On a fail it is banished to a harmless spot in the Feywild, with speed 0 and incapacitated. It comes back when its next turn ends, reappearing where it was (or in the nearest unoccupied space).
Level 18: the hit also deals 2d6 force damage.

name: Beguiling Arrow
trigger: Your magic arrow hits
description: Enchantment. The target takes an extra 2d6 psychic damage. Pick one of your allies no more than 30 ft from the target: the target makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by that ally until your next turn starts. The charm breaks early if that ally attacks it, damages it or forces it to save.
Level 18: 4d6 psychic.

name: Bursting Arrow
trigger: Your magic arrow hits
description: Evocation. Right after your attack, force energy bursts out: the target and all others no more than 10 ft from it each take 2d6 force damage.
Level 18: 4d6 force.

name: Enfeebling Arrow
trigger: Your magic arrow hits
description: Necromancy. The target takes an extra 2d6 necrotic damage and makes a Constitution save. On a fail, its weapon attacks deal only half damage until your next turn starts.
Level 18: 4d6 necrotic.

name: Grasping Arrow
trigger: Your magic arrow hits
description: Conjuration. Poisonous brambles wrap the target: it takes an extra 2d6 poison damage and its speed drops by 10 ft. Each turn, the first time it moves at least 1 ft other than by teleporting, it takes 2d6 slashing damage.

The brambles stay for 1 minute, or until you fire another Grasping Arrow. Anyone able to reach the target (the target included) can spend an action to pull them off by beating your Arcane Shot save DC with a Strength (Athletics) check.
Level 18: the poison and slashing damage both become 4d6.

name: Piercing Arrow
trigger: You fire the arrow (no attack roll)
description: Transmutation. No attack roll: the arrow flies in a line 1 ft wide and 30 ft long, passing through objects and ignoring cover, then vanishes.
Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save. On a fail it takes the arrow's normal hit damage plus an extra 1d6 piercing; on a success, half as much.
Level 18: the extra piercing becomes 2d6.

name: Seeking Arrow
trigger: You fire the arrow (no attack roll)
description: Divination. No attack roll: name a creature you saw within the past minute, and the arrow hunts it down, rounding corners and ignoring half and three-quarters cover.
The target must be in the weapon's range with a route big enough for the arrow to reach it; then it makes a Dexterity save. Otherwise the arrow flies as far as it can and disappears.
On a fail the target takes the arrow's normal hit damage plus an extra 1d6 force, and you learn where it is right now. On a success it takes half the damage and you learn nothing of its whereabouts.
Level 18: the extra force becomes 2d6.

name: Shadow Arrow
trigger: Your magic arrow hits
description: Illusion. The target takes an extra 2d6 psychic damage and makes a Wisdom save. On a fail it can't see anything more than 5 ft away until your next turn starts.
Level 18: 4d6 psychic.

name: Unwavering Mark
trigger: A creature you marked damages someone other than you
description: Mark: whenever your melee weapon attack hits a creature, you may mark it. The mark lasts until your next turn is over, and it ends early if you die or are incapacitated, or once another creature marks the target.
While a marked creature is within 5 ft of you, it has disadvantage on attack rolls aimed at anyone else.

Punish: if a creature you marked deals damage to someone who is not you, then on your next turn you can use a bonus action for a special melee weapon attack on it, with advantage. A hit adds half your fighter level to the weapon's damage.
Uses of the special attack per long rest equal your Strength modifier (minimum 1), shared across all your marks.

name: Warding Maneuver
trigger: An attack hits you or a visible creature no more than 5 ft away
description: You need a shield or melee weapon in hand. Roll 1d8 and add the roll to the target's AC for that attack only. Should it hit anyway, the target resists that attack's damage.

name: Hold the Line
trigger: A creature moves 5 ft or more while inside your reach
description: Spend your reaction on an opportunity attack against it. Moving 5 ft or more within your reach provokes you, even if the creature never leaves it.
Whenever your opportunity attack hits, the target's speed becomes 0 for the rest of that turn.

name: Ferocious Charger
trigger: You hit a creature after moving 10 ft or more straight toward it
description: Mounted or on foot, charge 10 ft or more in a straight line, then attack a creature. On a hit it makes a Strength save or is knocked prone. DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus.

name: Vigilant Defender
trigger: A creature provokes an opportunity attack from you on someone else's turn
description: In combat you get one special reaction on each other creature's turn, never on your own. It is good only for opportunity attacks, and it is unavailable on any turn where you already took your normal reaction.

name: Fighting Spirit
description: Bonus action on your turn: your weapon attack rolls have advantage until this turn ends, and you gain 5 temporary hit points. The temporary hit points rise to 10 at fighter level 10 and to 15 at level 15.
You have 3 uses, restored by a long rest.

name: Tireless Spirit
trigger: You roll initiative with no Fighting Spirit uses left
description: You get 1 use of Fighting Spirit back.

name: Rapid Strike
trigger: During your Attack action, you have advantage on one of your attack rolls
description: Give up the advantage on that roll to gain one extra weapon attack against that same target, inside the same Attack action.

name: Strength before Death
trigger: Damage drops you to 0 HP without killing you outright
description: Use your reaction to put off falling unconscious and take an extra turn at once, interrupting the current one.

During that turn, damage you take at 0 hit points still causes death save failures, and 3 failures still kill you. You drop unconscious at the end of that extra turn unless you have regained hit points.

name: Blind Fighting
description: You have blindsight out to 10 ft. Inside that range you see anything not behind total cover, even while blinded or in darkness.
Invisible creatures in that range are visible to you too, unless one manages to hide from you.

name: Interception
trigger: An attack by a creature you can see hits another target within 5 ft of you
description: Reduce the damage to that target by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus (never below 0).
Only works while you wield a shield or any simple or martial weapon.

name: Superior Technique
uses: 1 die (d6), refills on short or long rest
description: Pick one maneuver from the Maneuvers list (the Battle Master options) in the Superior Technique slot of the Options step. If it calls for a save, the DC is 8 + proficiency bonus + Str or Dex modifier (your choice).
You also gain one superiority die, a d6, which pays for your maneuvers and adds to any superiority dice you already have. Spent dice return on a short or long rest.

name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
description: Drawing a thrown weapon happens during the attack you make with it.
A ranged attack with a thrown weapon deals +2 damage when it hits.

name: Unarmed Fighting
description: Your unarmed strikes can deal 1d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage. If you hold no weapon or shield when you roll the attack, use 1d8 instead.
When each of your turns starts, you may deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage to one creature you are grappling.

name: Blessed Warrior
description: Pick 2 cleric cantrips. For you they are paladin spells, cast with Charisma.
Each time you gain a paladin level, you may swap one of them for a different cleric cantrip.

name: Druidic Warrior
description: Pick 2 druid cantrips. For you they are ranger spells, cast with Wisdom.
Each time you gain a ranger level, you may swap one of them for a different druid cantrip.

name: Ambush
trigger: You make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or roll initiative
description: Add the die to the roll. Not while you're incapacitated.

name: Bait and Switch
trigger: On your turn, a willing creature is within 5 ft of you
description: Trade places with that creature by spending at least 5 ft of movement; it can't be incapacitated. This move draws no opportunity attacks.
Roll the die: you or that creature (your pick) adds the roll to AC until your next turn starts.

name: Brace
trigger: A creature you can see moves into your melee weapon's reach
description: Make one attack against it with that weapon. On a hit, the die joins the damage roll.

name: Commanding Presence
trigger: You make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion) check
description: Add the die to the check.

name: Grappling Strike
trigger: Your melee attack hits a creature during your turn
description: Straight after that hit, spend a bonus action to attempt a grapple on the creature, adding the die to your Strength (Athletics) check. Grappling rules: Player's Handbook.

name: Quick Toss
description: Make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon, drawing it as part of the attack. On a hit, the die joins the damage roll.

name: Tactical Assessment
trigger: You make an Intelligence (Investigation or History) or Wisdom (Insight) check
description: Add the die to the check.

name: Psionic Power
description: Your psionic powers run on a pool of Psionic Energy dice: twice your proficiency bonus of them. A power that needs a die is unusable while the pool is empty.
The whole pool comes back when you finish a long rest. Once per short or long rest you can also win back a single die as a bonus action (Psionic Power (Regain)).
Die size grows with fighter level: d6, then d8 at 5, d10 at 11 and d12 at 17.
Powers: Protective Field, Psionic Strike and Telekinetic Movement; Telekinetic Adept (level 7) adds Psi-Powered Leap and Telekinetic Thrust.

name: Psionic Power (Regain)
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Get back one spent Psionic Energy die.

name: Protective Field
trigger: Damage lands on you or on a visible creature within 30 ft
description: Roll the die and cut the damage by the roll + your Intelligence modifier (at least 1), as a brief shield of telekinetic force springs up.

name: Psionic Strike
trigger: A weapon attack of yours hits and damages a target within 30 ft
uses: Once on each of your turns
description: Roll the die: the target takes force damage equal to the roll + your Intelligence modifier.

Level 7 (Telekinetic Thrust): when this damages the target, it makes a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier); on a failure, you knock it prone or shove it up to 10 ft horizontally, in any direction.

name: Telekinetic Movement
resource: 1 Psionic Energy die (after the free use)
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Move a loose object (Large or smaller) or a willing creature other than you up to 30 ft, into an empty space in your sight. The target must be within 30 ft and visible; the move can be horizontal, vertical or both.
A Tiny object can instead fly to or from your hand.
The first use is free; using it again before a short or long rest costs a Psionic Energy die.

name: Psi-Powered Leap
resource: 1 Psionic Energy die (after the free use)
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Fly this turn, at a speed of double your walking speed.
The first use is free; using it again before a short or long rest costs a Psionic Energy die.

name: Guarded Mind
trigger: Your turn begins while you are charmed or frightened
description: Spend a die to end every effect on you that is charming or frightening you.
Always on: resistance to psychic damage.

name: Bulwark of Force
resource: 1 Psionic Energy die (after the free use)
description: Grant half cover to visible creatures within 30 ft, you among them if you like, up to your Intelligence modifier in number (minimum 1). It lasts 1 minute, ending early if you are incapacitated.
The first use is free; using it again before a long rest costs a Psionic Energy die.

name: Telekinetic Master
resource: 1 Psionic Energy die (after the free use)

spells.uses: Once per long rest, or spend a Psionic Energy die

description: Cast telekinesis with no components; Intelligence is its spellcasting ability.
While you concentrate on it, you also get a weapon attack as a bonus action each turn (Telekinetic Master (Attack)).
The first casting is free; casting it again before a long rest costs a Psionic Energy die.

name: Telekinetic Master (Attack)
description: Make one weapon attack. Available every turn you are concentrating on the telekinesis from Telekinetic Master, including the turn you cast it.

name: Rune Carver
trigger: You finish a long rest
uses: Each rune: once per short or long rest (twice from level 15)
description: Carve each rune you know onto its own object: a weapon, armor, a shield, jewelry, or any other worn or hand-held item. Each object takes one of your runes, which lasts until your next long rest.
A rune grants a benefit while you wear or carry its object, and you can invoke it for a stronger effect. Rune save DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.
Each time you gain a fighter level you can swap one known rune for another. Hill Rune and Storm Rune need fighter level 7.
Level 15 (Master of Runes): each rune can be invoked twice per short or long rest.

name: Giant's Might
description: For 1 minute you take on a giant's might:
• If you are smaller than Large and have room, you and what you wear grow to Large.
• Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saves.
• One hit with a weapon or unarmed strike on each of your turns deals an extra 1d6 damage.
Level 10 (Great Stature): the extra damage becomes 1d8.
Level 18 (Runic Juggernaut): it becomes 1d10, and you can grow to Huge instead; while Huge, your reach is 5 ft longer.

name: Runic Shield
trigger: An attack roll hits a creature other than you, within 60 ft and in sight
description: The attacker rerolls the d20 and must keep the second roll.

name: Cloud Rune
trigger: An attack roll hits you or a visible creature within 30 ft
uses: Once per short or long rest (twice from level 15)
description: Invoke: pick another creature within 30 ft, not the attacker. The attack hits it instead, with the same roll, whatever the attack's range.
Carried: Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) and Charisma (Deception) checks have advantage.

name: Fire Rune
trigger: You hit a creature with a weapon attack
uses: Once per short or long rest (twice from level 15)
description: Invoke: fiery shackles. Deal 2d6 extra fire damage; the target then makes a Strength save or is restrained for 1 minute.
While shackled it takes 2d6 fire damage as each of its turns begins, and it saves again as each of its turns ends, breaking free on a success.
Carried: double your proficiency bonus on ability checks that use a tool you are proficient with.

name: Frost Rune
uses: Once per short or long rest (twice from level 15)
description: Invoke: +2 to every Strength and Constitution check and saving throw for 10 minutes.
Carried: Wisdom (Animal Handling) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks have advantage.

name: Stone Rune
trigger: A visible creature within 30 ft finishes its turn
uses: Once per short or long rest (twice from level 15)
description: Invoke: it makes a Wisdom save or falls under your charm for 1 minute, sunk in a dreamy stupor: speed 0 and incapacitated. It saves again as each of its turns ends; one success frees it.
Carried: Wisdom (Insight) checks have advantage, and you have darkvision out to 120 ft.

name: Hill Rune
uses: Once per short or long rest (twice from level 15)
description: Invoke: for 1 minute you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
Carried: advantage on saves against being poisoned, and resistance to poison damage.

name: Storm Rune
uses: Once per short or long rest (twice from level 15)
description: Invoke: for 1 minute you see glimpses of the future (it ends early if you are incapacitated). Meanwhile, when you or a visible creature within 60 ft makes an attack roll, saving throw or ability check, your reaction can give that roll advantage or disadvantage.
Carried: Intelligence (Arcana) checks have advantage, and you can't be surprised while you aren't incapacitated.

name: Rallying Cry
trigger: You use Second Wind
description: Using Second Wind, you can also heal up to three allies within 60 ft. Each regains HP equal to your fighter level, if it can see or hear you.

name: Inspiring Surge
trigger: You use Action Surge
description: Using Action Surge, you can pick an ally within 60 ft (see Allies). Each one can make a melee or ranged weapon attack as its reaction, if it can see or hear you.

name: Bulwark
trigger: You use Indomitable on an Int, Wis or Cha save
description: When you use Indomitable on an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save and are not incapacitated, pick one ally within 60 ft that failed a save against the same effect.
If it can see or hear you, it rerolls the save and must keep the new roll.
